description:
Hi, 
 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 ​ 
 
 
 Job Title: PHP Developer 
 Duration: 12 Months 
 Location: Jacksonville, FL 
 Job Description: 
We are seeking a full stack PHP Developer. Highly skilled in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Candidate will be detail-oriented and demonstrate a keen sense of aesthetics. Familiar with mainstream PHP frameworks (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony, etc). Must have experience working with jQuery and Bootstrap, Required to work independently and take the lead on small to medium projects. Excellent problem solving skills. Top notch verbal and written communication skills. Ability to install and maintain development environments for a LAMP platform. 
 Required Skills  3+ years of PHP 

 2+ years PHP Frameworks such as Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony, etc 

 2+ years Front-end technologies (AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) 

 2+ years jQuery and Bootstrap 

 2+ years MySQL experience, with strong ability create efficient, normalized database design 

 2+ years Linux experience 

 Good understanding of Git 

 The ideal candidate will have exposure to Kafka and this is highly desired 

 Desired Skills  
 Self starter. Independent thinker. Ability to problem solve and think through complex issues. Keen eye for aesthetics. 

 Kafka is highly desired

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you.  

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
